jess (AE): Heads-up — Customer signed MSA. They want a POC + committed reservation for ~100k qps-month (peaks ~5k RPS). Need recommended reserved GPU config, burst rules, preheat runbook, and ballpark pricing for quantized vs fp16. Also security Q: KMS + 13mo logs.
omar (sales_eng): They also called out p99 token latency target 200ms and 40% chat traffic with ~2k token contexts. Asking if a Dedicated plan with VPC peering covers KMS/audit.
li (solutions): Recommendation: start with 6 reserved GPUs (A100/80 equiv) split AZs 3+3. Allow burst to 9 GPUs via burst credits. KV cache warmup can cut token ops ~25-35% for sessioned flows.
ravi (infra): Ops notes: AZ spread reduces single-AZ eviction risk. Preheat recipe: 2hr staggered warmup ending at ramp T0. Smoke test at 75% of expected peak. Autoscale rules: scale_up if gpu_util>70% for 30s -> +1 GPU, scale_down if gpu_util<30% for 5m -> -1 GPU.
jess (AE): Pricing ask — committed discount + burst credits. Can you give a quick low/med/high monthly range for 6-GPU baseline fp16 vs 4-bit quant?
li (solutions): Ballpark: fp16 baseline ~ "$72k/mo" for 6 GPUs. With 4-bit quant + batching expect ~40-50% reduction -> "$36k-$44k/mo". Burst credits billed at a marginal premium (e.g., +10% on unit price). I'll send formal calc for the quote.
ops-bot: reservation-check: capacity OK in region; no conflicts.
jess (AE): Security: customer requires customer-managed KMS + 13mo audit logs + SOC2 reference. Is Dedicated sufficient?
omar (sales_eng): Legal said Dedicated + customer-managed KMS and audit-forwarding is sufficient unless they demand on-prem/air-gap. Add model license clause for third-party quantized models.
ravi (infra): Preheat checklist (short):
- T-120m: start KV warmup across reserved GPUs
- T-90m: run synthetic at 50% for 30m
- T-60m: run synthetic at 75% for 45m (validate p99 latency)
- T-0: enable burst credits for +50% capacity for up to 4h
Smoke commands: ./kv-warmup --model mix-quant --sessions 1200 --concurrency 120; ./loadgen --rps 3750 --ctx 2000 --duration 45m
li (solutions): Suggested conditional SLO text: "P99 latency SLO of 200ms while preheat runbook (KV warmup + synthetic smoke) is executed as specified; outside those windows latency is best-effort." Legal to formalize.
jess (AE): Can we paste an autoscale snippet into the quote? Keep it simple.
ravi (infra): Autoscale snippet (plain text): min_reserved_gpus=6, max_total_gpus=9, scale_up_threshold=0.7, scale_down_threshold=0.3, burst_limit_hours_per_month=120
li (solutions): Next steps: I'll post the detailed cost calc with per-GPU breakout and quantization sensitivity in 30m. Ravi will attach preheat/runbook and smoke pass criteria. Omar will draft pricing language for the quote.
jess (AE): Perfect — need final quote and AE deck numbers by EOD. Ping this thread when attachments are up. :thumbsup:
